questions.topic: Faithfulness: Is the Answer Grounded in the Context
questions.question: What does faithfulness measure?
options: Whether every claim in the answer is supported by the retrieved context
Whether the answer is factually true in the real world
Whether the retrieved documents match the query terms
Whether the answer follows the requested format

questions.topic: Faithfulness: Is the Answer Grounded in the Context
questions.question: How is a faithfulness score computed?
options: By comparing the answer to the user's click history
By counting words shared between question and answer
By decomposing the answer into atomic claims and verifying each against the context
By measuring the answer's embedding distance to the query

questions.question: An answer carries 6 atomic claims and 5 are supported by the context. What is its faithfulness score?

options: The generation layer hallucinated
The citation spans were misaligned
The judge model drifted
The retrieval layer supplied wrong evidence

questions.topic: Faithfulness: Is the Answer Grounded in the Context
questions.question: Why is faithfulness computed per claim rather than per answer?
options: One fabricated number inside a long fluent answer would be averaged away
Claims are cheaper to embed than full answers
Answers cannot be split into sentences reliably
Per-answer scoring requires gold references

questions.topic: Faithfulness: Is the Answer Grounded in the Context

The answer relevance score must be zero

questions.topic: Context Precision and Context Recall
questions.question: What does context recall measure?
options: The fraction of the corpus that was indexed
The fraction of the evidence needed to answer that is present in the retrieved context
The fraction of queries that return any documents
The fraction of answers that cite at least one source

questions.topic: Context Precision and Context Recall
questions.question: What does context precision measure?
options: How many chunks exist per document
How fast the retriever responds
How often the index is rebuilt
What fraction of the sent chunks are useful and well-ranked

questions.question: A relevant chunk sits at position 7 of 10 and the model ignores it. What effect explains this?
options: Models exploit the beginning and end of long contexts better than the middle
The reranker inverted the chunk ordering
The chunk exceeded the model's token limit
Embedding similarity decays with position

questions.topic: Context Precision and Context Recall
questions.question: Why are irrelevant chunks in the context worse than neutral filler?
options: They increase storage costs
They slow down indexing jobs
They reduce the RRF constant
They dilute attention and invite distraction-hallucination

questions.topic: Context Precision and Context Recall
questions.question: Context recall is 0.95 but context precision is 0.3, and answers weave in off-topic details. What is the first fix?

questions.question: What does answer relevance measure?

Whether the answer cites at least one source
Whether the response addresses the question actually asked
Whether the answer uses formal grammar
